text_block_list.text: "The Little Bird—now the Bluebird—"

"Today too, I spread my wings and take to the sky.
Giving it my all, I fly through the sky."

"Through the rain, through the wind,
even through the raging storms."

"I'm alright, I can still fly!
Don't worry, I'll definitely deliver it!"
"To everyone, to everyone, bringing happiness—"

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: Condition is very good.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Her body is coming along quite nicely.
Faster than expected, too—
Could she be getting an exceptionally solid diet?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, actually... my Trainer
made a whole bunch of supplemental snacks by hand for me."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We had steamed buns yesterday, and I even got seconds...
I'm sure that must be why...!

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...That is a very good thing.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I cannot say all concerns have vanished. However, for now, regarding her full-scale return to racing—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: At present, I have no reason to stop you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I, did it……

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer!
Can we talk about the race right away?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run.
I need to get results as soon as possible...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest—I thought she might say that
depending on the results of today's regular checkup.
Knowing how hardworking she is.
choice_data_list: I've got a few candidates lined up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, using the materials I had brought along,
I explain the potential target races to K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, even as she listened closely to the explanation,
K.S.Miracle seemed restless the entire time—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'd prefer an early one...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"An early one... I'd prefer a race I can enter right away, if possible.
Just, the earliest one there is—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Out of the options Trainer showed me earlier... next month's 'Aoi Stakes.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I've made it this far without incident.
And what's more, I've become stronger than before.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The miracle given to me
is granting me so much strength.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My feelings of gratitude
just keep swelling bigger every single day—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I gotta hurry up
and start repaying my debt to them.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please.
If it's okay for me to not hold back anymore...
I want to enter... the Aoi Stakes.
choice_data_list: …Okay, our goal is the Aoi Stakes!
…Okay, our goal is the Aoi Stakes!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
I look forward to worki—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!
It's Kei-chan--!!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child A
text_block_list.text:
You're here!
Hey, hey, play the piano again!
Sing us a song!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child B
text_block_list.text:
You know what? I drew a picture of Kei-chan!
I drew it super duper well!
Look, look!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...!
Um—
choice_data_list: Go on ahead, I'll be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for calling out to me, everyone.
Shall we head to the playroom together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We've ended up in similar situations during routine health checkups before, but... as always, her kind demeanor makes her wildly popular with children.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finding it heartwarming, I listened closely to the
faint sound of piano music drifting over, when—

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san.
Could I speak with you for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the hospital cafe, K.S. Miracle's parents first treated me to a cup of coffee.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
Please let me do at least this much.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
I hear she's finally going to start entering races in earnest...
I feel like all I ever do is bow my head to you,
but I am truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"She looked so happy herself, too.
...It was her dream, truly.
To run... to compete in races."

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... Would you mind
if I shared a little story from the past?"
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, there's something I'd like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she was very little... she's been a patient child.
Never complaining, always smiling quietly.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"We're a dual-income household, so there were days neither my husband nor I
could visit her in the hospital...
Yet, she never once said she felt lonely."

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
She was at an age where she should've been playing and learning her fill...
Yet even when she couldn't go outside or attend school,
she never uttered a single word of complaint.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Still, there was just one thing.
One thing that she brought up entirely on her own.

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: “...I want... to run.”

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Just like that... I want to run, too."

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
She was pointing at the TV with a slender finger.
...It was a special broadcast about the girls
who were making huge waves in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I want to be able to... run. Me too—"

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...If there's anything we can do,
please don't hesitate to say the word.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And... please continue to be a pillar of support for her.
...A support for that girl's one and only dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod, hoping my resolve reaches her.
A young child who never threw tantrums, never asked for anything, and merely smiled in silence... This was her one and only dream—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's make them come true.
Starting with the Aoi Stakes.
